messages:
Sana R.: Heads-up: onboarding sample is failing under strict pyright in our monorepo. The SDK generator emits 'Any' for a bunch of response fields and stream chunks are raw dicts. Minimal repro:
```py
resp = await client.chat.create(prompt="hey")
# pyright: "Property \"text\" does not exist on type \"Any\"" when doing resp.output[0].text

async for chunk in client.chat.stream(prompt="hi"):
    # pyright: Property 'text' does not exist on type 'dict'
    print(chunk['text'])
```

Tyler (sdk): Thanks Sana. We're aware the generator has been conservative to avoid runtime overhead. Two quick wins we can ship: 1) tighten param types (map integer/number to int/float, boolean -> bool) so method signatures are useful, and 2) add a shallow TypedDict (TypedChunk) for streams with common keys (text: str | None, role: str | None, done: bool | None).

Sana R.: That would drastically reduce noise. Right now editors and CI flag every access in examples which blocks new hires.

Maya (devex): Can we also add an examples/typed_stream.py and examples/typed_chat.py that are clean under both mypy and pyright? We should gate the onboarding guide on those passing in CI.

Tyler (sdk): Plan outline:
- Emit Response[T] generic wrapper for non-streaming calls and use it in stubs (Response[ChatResponse]).
- For streaming: AsyncIterator[TypedChunk] with shallow conversion by default; add client flag `return_raw_stream: bool = False` to opt into raw dicts for perf-sensitive apps.
- Generate .pyi stubs for the public SDK surface so strict typecheckers get good signatures without forcing expensive runtime parsing.
- Map nullable -> Optional[...] and oneOf -> Union[...] where safe.

Sana R.: .pyi stubs + a shallow stream TypedDict sounds great. Also please make sure the param annotations include types like temperature: float | None and max_tokens: int | None so mypy catches obvious mistakes.

Tyler (sdk): Agreed. We'll add a small mypy/pyright job in CI that typechecks the examples folder. For pydantic compatibility we'll emit a version guard and shims for v1 vs v2 in generated code.

build-bot: Created ticket SDK-TYP-778: "python-sdk: .pyi stubs, Response[T], TypedChunk, and examples CI" assigned to @tyler_sdk

Maya (devex): Also document the opt-out flags and include a short migration note for teams that vendor the SDK (stubs-only vs runtime models). New hires often vendor the mini-sdk for CI.

Sana R.: One more thing: streaming chunk typing should include a minimal TypedDict for the delta structure too when keys are fixed (e.g., {'content': str}). It can be optional to avoid breaking unknown shapes.

Tyler (sdk): Noted. We'll emit shallow TypedDicts for top-level known shapes (chunk, delta) and keep unknown keys typed as Any inside a separate field. Targeting a small 0.9.x patch for param typing and TypedDict streams, and a 0.10.0-alpha for full .pyi stubgen + examples.

Maya (devex): Thanks. CC devex when the PR lands so we can update the onboarding checklist and sample-app templates. Small wins here reduce a surprising amount of friction.

Tyler (sdk): Will do. I'll open a draft PR with generator template changes and two example files. Ping back with CI output and I'll iterate. :rocket:
